name: Mighty Arcade
author: Moby Pixel
tagline: A box of casual games that make music
description: Mighty Arcade, from the creator of Mighty Arp: eighteen casual games, from chess and solitaire to pinball and arcade classics, every one a sequencer. Each move, each card, each cleared row plays the music. One player or two.
credits: Built on fm1-base by Charles Vestal and felucca-bsp; the sound engine is Mighty Arp's
